processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: As-cast condition without subsequent heat treatment; produces large primary austenitic dendrites with grain structures on the order of millimeters.

phases_present.morphology: Large primary dendrites with secondary arms (orange-tan dendrite cores separated by darker bluish-grey interdendritic regions)

interfaces.interface_notes: Interdendritic regions appear darker (bluish-grey) relative to the orange-tan dendrite cores; these are microsegregation features within the austenite, not reported as distinct phase interfaces.

characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: etched using 10% nital; 100 µm scale bar
characterization_methods.key_findings: Large primary austenite dendrites with secondary arms; small dark spherical inclusions scattered throughout

unmapped_findings: Nominal composition of this sample is Fe-28Mn-3Al-0.9Si-1.2C-0.6Mo (wt.%), as given in the Fig. 1a caption.

This sample serves as the as-cast microstructural example in Fig. 1a; the paper reports no tensile, hardness, Charpy impact, or dynamic fracture toughness data specific to this composition (Tables II-IV concern the Fe-30Mn-9Al-XSi-0.9C steel family).
